title: closure-rule-system
description: A versionable closure-rule system. Generates the closure operator cl^S whose firing realizes the closure 2-monad's algebra on the substrate. Fields: id, version-hash, rules, scope-applicability, closure-kind-distribution, rule-language-fragment, fuel-policy, predecessor.

version-hash.description: Canonical-form hash of the rule-set's content. Two byte-identical systems must have identical version-hashes.

rules.description: References to the closure-rule records the system includes. Each must resolve to an existing substrate entity.

scope-applicability.description: References to the scopes the rule system is potential in.

closure-kind-distribution.description: Derived count of rules per closure-kind. Sums to total rules per the closure-kind invariant.

rule-language-fragment.description: Determines the regime of the substrate's settling. Quantifier-free => strict or Scott-continuous regime. With-forall-blocks => transfinite-bounded or aperiodic regime.

fuel-policy.description: Reference to the fuel-bound discipline. Must be regime-compatible with rule-language-fragment.

predecessor.description: Reference to the prior version of this rule-system. Predecessor chain must terminate at a bootstrap version per the acyclic-predecessor-chain invariant.
